{{Quote|Oh, dear. You say the engine needs a new supply of space crystals?''"<br />[R2-D2's circuits light up and whirr]<br />"''And they can only be found in the deepest cave on this planet? Then let's go!|C-3PO and R2-D2|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
'''Space crystals''' were [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] that could be essential components of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]]. A deposit of the crystals could be found in the deepest [[Cave/Legends|cave]] on a [[Unidentified planet (space crystals)|planet]] that was once visited by the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. When the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] realized their [[Unidentified gold spacecraft|starship]] required a new supply of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] crystals, they trekked across the planet's surface to retrieve a deposit of the material from the planet's cave.

==Description==
{{Quote|''[R2-D2 loudly clicks and beeps]<br />"''You say the crystals are always found near a smelly orange fungus.|quotestart=0|R2-D2 and C-3PO|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
Space crystals were a type of [[Color/Legends|blue]]-colored [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. They could be found in deep [[Cave/Legends|caves]], and a type of [[Unidentified orange fungus|orange fungus]] commonly grew in the vicinity of the crystals' deposits. [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] crystals could be an essential component to the operation of the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], with an example being a single-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Unidentified gold spacecraft|craft]] at some point used by the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="Shiny" />

==History==
{{Quote|We must be very close!|C-3PO, to R2-D2 while at the mouth of a cave|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
[[File:Gold_spacecraft-Shiny_as_a_Droid.jpg|thumb|right|300px|At one point, C-3PO and R2-D2 found themselves needing to replace their starship's supply of space crystals.]]
At one point, the pair of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used the starship to land on a [[Unidentified planet (space crystals)|terrestrial planet]]. Before they could travel to<ref name="Shiny" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], however, R2-D2 discovered that their ship needed a new supply of space crystals. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] informed his companion that they could only find a deposit of the crystals in the deepest cave on the planet, at which point the pair undertook a trip to obtain the material.<ref name="Shiny" />

Ultimately, the droids arrived at the cave, where C-3PO inferred from the presence of the particular [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] at the cave's mouth that they were close to the deposit. Shortly thereafter, R2-D2 and C-3PO noticed space crystals shining through an opening in the cave wall. The satisfied droids subsequently took an amount of the crystals back to their spacecraft and, loading them into its engine, proceeded to travel offworld.<ref name="Shiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Young children will find that outer space is no farther than their fingertips when they stroke a serpent's scaly stomach, touch a strange hairy plant, scratch and sniff an alien fungus&mdash;and more&mdash;while helping Artoo-Detoo and See-Threepio search for the crystal they need to fix their spacecraft.|Back cover of ''Shiny as a Droid''|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
Space crystals appeared in ''[[Shiny as a Droid]]'', a [[1986]] children's book written by [[Virginia Holt]] and illustrated by [[Feito]].<ref name="Shiny" />
